subject: general
question: Four letter-clusters have been given, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the odd letter-cluster.
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ba9641975f2fc7524ff111ee5de92ae0deecda54903f9932e1bcb1ebbbc99a46.png] 

**Logic: **Letter + 4 = Next letter

 
• BFJN → B + 4 = F; F + 4 = J; J + 4 = N
 
• DHLP → D + 4 = H; H + 4 = L; L + 4 = P
 
• **HJKP → H + 2 = J; J + 1 = K; K + 5 = P**
 
• JNRV → J + 4 = N; N + 4 = R; R + 4 = V

Hence, '**HJKP**' is the correct answer.
